body_markdown:
11/16/26


Semrush’s Algorithm Update Sharpens Traffic & Market Data


The Traffic & Market toolkit runs on a new traffic prediction algorithm and machine learning model built for channel prediction.


Semrush is raising the bar again for data quality and accuracy. As of November 9, the Traffic & Market toolkit, designed for competitive intelligence and market research, runs on a brand new traffic prediction algorithm, supported by a broader set of data sources, recalculated metrics from January 2023 onwards, and a purpose-built machine learning model engineered for channel prediction. The result? More accurate traffic estimates and deeper precision in traffic source attribution.


Teams using the Trends API to access web traffic and market data will also benefit from this update, bringing the improved data directly into custom dashboards and workflows.


Key Improvements: Stronger Estimates, Smarter Attribution


Marketers need clarity on total traffic and the exact channels driving it, in order to accurately attribute marketing efforts towards conversions and outperform competitors. Our upgraded model sharpens both metrics, delivering a stronger foundation for competitive analysis and market benchmarking.


1. Stronger Traffic Estimates


More accurate traffic estimates provide a clearer view of market trends, helping marketers identify shifts in competitor performance and market dynamics. The upgraded model now predicts domain traffic with greater accuracy:


- Up to 40% improvement for large domains in the US
- Up to 30% improvement for small and medium-sized domains worldwide


With it, marketers can benchmark competitors, size market opportunities, and assess any domain's online performance with greater confidence.


2. Smarter Channel Attribution


Traffic channel predictions are now more accurate, featuring:


- Up to 45% improvement for small and medium-sized domains in the US
- Up to 42% improvement for small and medium-sized domains worldwide


With this, teams can pinpoint which channels drive competitors' growth and allocate their own budgets accordingly.


Maximizing Brand Visibility and Impact


With more accurate traffic and channel data, marketers gain a clearer picture of their brand visibility to make better-informed decisions about where to focus their efforts. From benchmarking performance against competitors and identifying emerging market opportunities to understanding which acquisition channels drive growth, these improvements help teams refine their strategies and invest resources with greater confidence.


Note: Semrush Trends API has recalculated historical data with the new algorithm to align past and current data. Values may differ from what was retrieved previously. If the update affects your reporting, reach out to our team.
